title: Derived-unit and adjunction normalized constant-tower site transport
statement: With the ordinary constant-module transport and exact tower equivalence $C_T$ of [def-sf-integral-compactification-ordinary-site-transport], derive the termwise direct-image square on strict towers [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The direct-image comparison is the unique natural isomorphism $\mathrm R f_*C_T\cong C_V\mathrm R f_*^{\rm model}$ whose composite with the universal derived unit agrees, on every cochain complex, with the termwise section-normalized comparison, using the exact-localization factorization $QC_T\cong C_T^{\rm Ch}Q$. Define directModel to be this unique comparison. Define pullModelMap as its adjunction mate for the published derived pullback/direct-image adjunctions; this mate is invertible, and pullModel is the resulting isomorphism. For an open immersion $j$ and a presentation of the adjunction between the fixed model extension-by-zero and pullback functors [lem-sf-constant-semilinear-generator-comparison], define openModelMap as the mate of pullModel inverse under the published open adjunctions. It too is invertible; openModel is its inverse-direction isomorphism. All comparisons use the exact small-site equivalences, their universal derived units, and the specified adjunctions, including empty opens.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary section-normalized comparison termwise, with the whiskering compositors, to obtain towerDirectModel. The vertical functors towerModel are exact additive equivalences, and their derived functors and localization factorizations are the specified derivedTowerModel and modelFactors.

For the termwise square F Q ≅ P G, use the adopted source-library instances isRightDerivedFunctor_rightDerivedFunctor_comp_mapDerivedCategory and isRightDerivedFunctor_mapDerivedCategory_comp_rightDerivedFunctor: RF D(Q) and D(P) RG are universal right derived pairs of F Q and P G, respectively. Exactness of Q gives the first instance; P is an additive equivalence, hence preserves K-injective complexes, giving the second. Apply Mathlib rightDerivedNatIso to the homotopy-category image of towerDirectModel. In the proved private helper normalizedSquare, compute both derived units on a complex K using mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and directCochainUnit. Cancel the invertible localization-factorization maps to identify the universal unit equation with DirectModelNormalization for every K. Conversely the same cancellation and surjectivity of the homotopy quotient on objects recover the universal unit equation from that predicate. Mathlib rightDerived_ext and Iso.ext then prove uniqueness. Specialize this helper to the original and small-model tower direct images; their right derived functors are definitionally the published R and towerPush.

The two derived site transports are equivalences. The proved private inverseMate_isIso helper applies the adopted source theorem isIso_mateEquiv_of_isEquivalence to the opposite adjunctions, identifies its mate componentwise with the opposite of the inverse-direction mate, and reflects invertibility from opposite morphisms. Apply it first to directModel and the specified pullback/direct-image adjunctions to prove pullModelMap_isIso. Apply it again to pullModel inverse and the specified open adjunctions to prove openModelMap_isIso. This argument imposes no nonemptiness or properness condition and includes the empty open.
